title: Large Project Workflow
objective: Menguji project besar dengan dokumen panjang, banyak entitas, media, timeline, graph, dan relasi.

evidence.dataset_manifest: Workflow manifest mencatat project identity, dokumen panjang, entitas, media, timeline clips, dan graph relations.
evidence.latency_results: Tracer menghasilkan hasil bounded untuk document index dan graph query; benchmark runner mengukur reference listing dan timeline range.
evidence.memory_results: Workflow mencatat working set bounded sebagai kontrak fail-closed lokal.
evidence.storage_results: Workflow mencatat media manifest dan timeline index complete.
evidence.failure_results: Missing media dan index rebuild dinyatakan recoverable/non-destructive.
evidence.acceptance: Fokus 2/2 PASS; regression benchmark 4/4 PASS; scoped analyzer No issues; format dan diff-check PASS. Evidence local deterministic/synthetic; native GUI, production-scale endurance, hosted CI, signing, hardware, dan public release tetap UNVERIFIABLE.
